title: Barobi ba Selekane ba Lelekiloeng
intro: Mehleng ea pele ea sechaba se secha, moloko o kile oa lula matlong a etselitsoeng liqhobosheane, o tlamiloe ke tumellano. Ha tumellano eo e ekoa, liphello li ile tsa utloahala maqepheng a Quran. Batho bana e ne e le bo-mang, hona ho ile ha etsahala'ng ka malapa a bona le lirapa tsa lifate tsa litholoana?
clues: Re ne re lula liqhobosheaneng tse neng li re fa maikutlo a fosahetseng a tšireletso.
Re ne re le batho ba Mangolo a Halalelang, empa re robile selekane sa rona.
Re ile ra rera khahlanong le lenģosa ka mor'a hore le tle ho rona, empa morero oa rona oa hloleha.
Lifate tsa rona tsa palema li ile tsa rengoa ka taelo ea Allah, e le pontšo ea matla a Hae.
Re ile ra lelekoa malapeng a rona, ra se hlole re khutla, e le kotlo bakeng sa ho se mamele ha rona.
Quran e re bua ka rona khaolong ea kopano, 'me pale ea rona e sebetsa e le temoso ho ba robang litumellano.

trial.answer: Ho thibelloa le ho lelekoa malapeng a bona

outcome.answer: Ba lelekiloe naheng 'me thepa ea bona ea nkoa

arabic: مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَىٰٓ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِىَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
verse: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allāh and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient. (59:5)
